viv: heads-up: found a weird fail in the TS SDK when using discriminator-style unions in toolcalls. After an auth-retry the discriminator field (`kind`) is missing and server schema rejects it.

tara: ugh. small reproducible snippet?

viv: minimal repro:
```ts
// @redwood/sdk-js
await client.callTool('process_task', { task: { kind: 'batch', items: [] } });
// force token refresh on first attempt -> retry
// server sees: { task: { items: [] } }  // missing `kind`
```
No middleware modifying payload. First attempt ok, retry drops discriminator.

ben: that sounds like the retry-queue merge running a shallow merge with defaults and accidentally dropping keys when using `Object.assign({}, defaults, payload)` where defaults have `task: {}`. If queueing serializes nested refs weirdly we can lose inner keys.

viv: i traced it: auth wrapper clones top-level args but not deep nested objects; then a normalize step does `payload.task = payload.task || {}` and later we re-serialize a shallow clone for backoff. deep path sometimes becomes an empty object on retry.

tara: CI caught this?

ci-bot: samples/batch-processor e2e failing — 1 test failing (toolcall-discriminator.test.ts)

ben: assign to @sdk-team. fix approach: preserve deep shape when queueing for retry (deep-copy or keep original reference), and avoid eager normalization until send-time. Prefer UNSET sentinel for absent keys so we can tell "missing" vs "present but empty".

viv: quick local patch: use structuredClone() for queued args and delay defaults merge to serializer. That fixed the repro for me.

@sdk-team: heads-up - streaming path also needs check. i saw similar missing nested fields when chunk reassembly created fresh empty objects.

sdk-team: acked. will add unit tests for discriminator unions, nested objects, streaming chunk reassembly, and auth-retry flows. Also add cross-sdk parity test vs python.

tara: add a test for nested union where discriminator is optional vs required to catch both cases.

ben: changelog suggestion: "fix(sdk): preserve nested discriminator fields on auth/retry for toolcall payloads (JSON mode)"

viv: PR #5120 opened with structuredClone-based queueing, serializer defers defaults, and new tests. included small netem script to force token refresh in CI.

ci-bot: linked issue #6842 created: "ts-sdk: discriminator field dropped on auth retry for nested toolcall objects"

sdk-team: will review today. plan backport to 1.4.x if approved. will run canary on dedicated infra post-merge.

tara: nice work. after merge I'll update sample assertions in batch-processor and run the regression suite. :thumbsup:

viv: thanks — ping me if reviewers want the netem script or a tiny repro harness. leaving the thread here to track backport/canary status.
